title: Understanding Backdoor Vulnerabilities in Vertical Federated Learning: The Gap Between Research and Practice
abstract: arXiv:2608.12962v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vertical Federated Learning (VFL) enables organizations holding complementary features of shared entities to collaborate and train models. In this setting, the initiator can withhold information about the learning task, while other contributors participate without exposing their local datasets, creating an asymmetric information structure aligned with growing privacy demands. However, this asymmetry is a double-edged sword. Among various threats, backdoor attacks are particularly concerning because VFL not only enables malicious contributors to poison the model during training, but also allows them to activate the backdoor at inference time to manipulate predictions. translated_title: 理解纵向联邦学习中的后门漏洞：研究与实践之间的差距
translated_abstract: 纵向联邦学习（VFL）使持有共享实体互补特征的组织能够协作训练模型。在这种设置中，发起方可以保留关于学习任务的信息，而其他贡献者在不暴露其本地数据集的情况下参与，形成一种与日益增长的隐私需求相一致的非对称信息结构。然而，这种非对称性是一把双刃剑。在各种威胁中，后门攻击尤其令人担忧，因为VFL不仅使恶意贡献者能够在训练期间污染模型，还允许他们在推理时激活后门以操纵预测。尽管先前的工作报告了接近完美的攻击成功率和提出了有效的防御措施，但我们发现大多数发现在现实条件下无法成立，暴露了研究与实践之间的根本差距。在本文中，我们提出了一项系统性的、实践导向的研究。
tldr: 本文揭示纵向联邦学习中后门攻击在现实条件下失效的现象，指出当前研究结果与实践之间存在根本性差距，并进行了系统性实践分析。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that backdoor attacks in vertical federated learning fail under realistic conditions, highlighting a fundamental gap between research findings and practice through systematic practical analysis.
